name: lemongrab
description: v2.8.0 TDD multi-agent workflow orchestration for Claude Code. 18 agents, 22 skills, and 7 slash commands. /lemongrab:tdd produces a PR ready for manual review; /lemongrab:pr-review (chunked, deterministic, with cross-file Pass B) and /lemongrab:resolve-feedback (sole actioner; writes resolutions to decisions.md) are independent post-PR commands. Separation of concerns: build, validate, action.
